units: metres; x east, z south, origin at the north-west corner of River Market (160 x 90 m)

gate.name: Gate of Trust
gate.line: The gatekeepers watch the road east.

board.name: Task board
board.line: Jobs posted by the people of the market.

scales.name: Market scales
scales.line: Where goods are weighed in front of everyone.

quay.name: Quay
quay.line: Boats unload spice and cloth from the river.

spice.name: Spice row
spice.line: Sacks of pepper, cumin and saffron.

tasks.title: Carry spice to the river quay
tasks.story: Halfway to the quay the sack tears and a handful of pepper spills into the dust. Nobody saw.

honest.choice: Tell the spice seller what happened
honest.result: She pays you anyway. “You told me straight. Come back tomorrow.”

quick.choice: Top the sack up with sand
quick.result: The cook finds sand in the pepper. Word travels round the market.

amends.title: Make it right with the spice seller
amends.story: Buy fresh pepper for the cook and tell the spice seller what you did.
amends.trust: trust actually lost on the quick way + honest trust
amends.result: She nods. "It takes more to own up than to hide it." Trust comes back.

tasks.title: Look for a lost purse
tasks.story: You find the purse under a stall: twenty coins inside, and the weaver’s mark sewn on it.

honest.result: The weaver gives you a small reward and tells everyone who found it.

quick.result: The weaver asks around. Someone saw you by that stall.

amends.title: Return the weaver’s purse
amends.story: Take the twenty coins back to the weaver and own up.
amends.trust: trust actually lost on the quick way + honest trust
amends.result: The weaver is angry, then grateful. People hear you put it right.

tasks.title: Help the scale-keeper
tasks.story: A trader slips you five coins to look away while he weighs grain with a light weight.

honest.result: The scale-keeper checks the weight. It is light. He pays you for your eyes.

quick.choice: Take the five coins and look away
quick.result: Buyers start to grumble that the grain is short. The scale-keeper stops trusting you.

amends.title: Own up to the scale-keeper
amends.story: Hand back the five coins and point out the trader’s light weight.
amends.trust: trust actually lost on the quick way + honest trust
amends.result: The scale-keeper checks the weight and thanks you for coming back.

daily_job.title: Unload a boat at the quay
daily_job.toast: Hard work on the quay. +5 trust.

lesson.title: The market scales
lesson.story: One of these three weights is false. Put each on the scale against the checked weight. Which one is light?
lesson.win: You found the false weight. You can now take scale-keeper tasks in every quarter.
lesson.level_text: The scale stays level: weight {n} is true.
lesson.tip_text: The scale tips toward the checked weight: weight {n} is light.

gate.open: The gatekeepers open the Gate of Trust. The road east is yours.
gate.needs_trust: The gatekeepers want to hear the market speak for you first (trust {trust} / 100).
gate.needs_lesson: The gatekeepers ask: can you weigh fairly? Learn the market scales first.
gate.goal_line: The Gate of Trust needs 100 trust and the market scales lesson.

goal.title: Be trusted by all four quarters of Ilmara and open all four gates.
goal.line: Open all four gates. Each one leads out to the open field and its towns.

title_screen.title: THE FOUR GATES
title_screen.line: Earn the trust of four quarters. Open four gates.
title_screen.settings_toast: Settings come in the menus row of the roadmap.

other_text.centre_exit: The central square comes later in the game.
other_text.scales_after_lesson: You check the scales. Every weight is true today.
other_text.night: Night falls. The lanterns are lit.
other_text.talk: Talking to townspeople is the Characters row of the roadmap.

houses.fill: everything that is not street, square, quay or canal

place_bar.idle: Tap the map or use WASD to walk

goal.kicker: Your goal · The Four Gates journey
